historical_record.description: A one-story-over-garage, single-family dwelling stood at the property.
The City Planning Commission did not take discretionary review and approved the demolition of a one-story-over-garage, single-family dwelling at 163 Collingwood Street.

The City Planning Commission took discretionary review and approved the construction of a three-story-over-garage, three-family dwelling at 163 Collingwood Street, with modifications to the south side lightwell on the upper level and the elimination of the 10-foot aluminum mass atop the building.
